candidate_relations.reason: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is a related aggressive B-cell lymphoma but is a different WHO subtype from grade 3A follicular lymphoma.
Thymoma does not explain the widespread adenopathy, chylous effusion, and B-cell clone.
Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma is a different B-cell lymphoma subtype.
Dyslipidemia is a listed comorbidity, not the lymphoma.
Hypertriglyceridemia as a systemic diagnosis is not the cause of the lymphocyte-rich, high-triglyceride pleural fluid from lymphoma.
Nodal lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma is a different lymphoma lineage from follicular lymphoma.
Sarcoidosis is a different cause of adenopathy and does not match the B-cell clone with aberrant BCL2.
Pleural effusion is the presenting manifestation, not the lymphoma diagnosis.
Primary effusion lymphoma is a distinct effusion-based lymphoma, not grade 3A follicular lymphoma with solid adenopathy.
Kaposi sarcoma is a different neoplasm and is not supported here.
Chylothorax is the pleural-fluid complication of lymphatic obstruction by lymphoma, not the lymphoma itself.
TAFRO-variant Castleman disease is a different systemic disorder and does not match this B-cell lymphoma phenotype.
Lymphoma is the correct parent category but missing follicular histology, grade 3A, and stage IVB.
Pseudochylothorax is cholesterol-rich fluid; this effusion had triglyceride 747 mg/dL, consistent with chyle rather than pseudochyle.
Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia is a different mature B-cell neoplasm.
Castleman disease is not supported by the B-cell clonality and PET-avid widespread adenopathy pattern of lymphoma.
Bronchogenic carcinoma is unlikely in a nonsmoker with lymphocyte-rich chylothorax and a B-cell clone.
Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma is a different lineage from follicular lymphoma.
Anaplastic large-cell lymphoma is a T-cell lymphoma, not follicular lymphoma.
Tuberculous pleurisy is a different cause of lymphocytic effusion and does not explain the clonal B-cell adenopathy.

case_quality_flags: No complete_equivalent candidate; high-grade 3A follicular lymphoma stage IVB is not named
Pathology shows mixed small-to-large B cells that can overlap FL3A and DLBCL
